Level 42.
Leather Armor
Stone Sword
3 Rockets (Firework)

Launch rockets at your enemies! Does the same amount of damage as a creeper explosion. 
Don't overheat the weapon! (5 Second cooldown time)
Oof, that rocket is heavy. (Permanent slowness I)
